description: Price up to 100 requests in one call. Each item in requests is the same request compute_price takes: a context with a three-letter currency and optionally a product, current price, segment, geo and metadata, plus an optional function_id, routing preference, constraints and options. Every item is one metered call, drawn together from your prepaid balance, all or nothing: a balance short of the whole batch charges nothing. An item that does not price comes back as an error in its place and is given back. Send the same idempotency_key to retry safely: a repeat answers from the first answer and re-runs only the items that did not price. Needs a Last Price credential with batch price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

idempotency_key.description: A new value for each batch you mean to run; send the same value to retry it.

requests.description: The price requests, at most 100, answered in the same order.

context.description: What is being priced: currency (required, three letters), product_id, product_type, current price, customer_segment, geo, channel and metadata.

request_id.description: Optional id to match the answer to the request.

routing_preference.description: How to pick a function when none is named.

name: compute_prices_batch
